# Official PiSecure Installation Commands
# Copy and paste these for quick installation

# ========================================
# RECOMMENDED: Full production install
# ========================================
pip install "git+https://github.com/UnderhillForge/PiSecure.git#egg=pisecure[full,native]"

# ========================================
# Alternative: Basic install
# ========================================
pip install git+https://github.com/UnderhillForge/PiSecure.git

# ========================================
# Development install
# ========================================
git clone https://github.com/UnderhillForge/PiSecure.git
cd PiSecure  
pip install -e ".[dev,native]"

# ========================================
# Raspberry Pi with all features
# ========================================
# First, install system dependencies:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y build-essential python3-dev git

# Then install PiSecure:
pip3 install "git+https://github.com/UnderhillForge/PiSecure.git#egg=pisecure[full,native]"

# Verify installation:
pisecure --version
pisecure status

# ========================================
# Docker one-liner
# ========================================
docker run -it --rm python:3.11-slim bash -c "
apt-get update && apt-get install -y build-essential git && \
pip install 'git+https://github.com/UnderhillForge/PiSecure.git#egg=pisecure[full,native]' && \
pisecure --version
"
